personnalite.pf_passion_d: For you, love is felt straight away or not at all. You love hard and fast, and you struggle to understand people who do it any other way. When a relationship starts, it takes up a lot of room: you think about them in the morning, you answer the message within the second, and you want evenings where the rest of the world stops existing. That's what makes your relationships feel alive, and it's also what wears you out when the intensity settles. Because it settles a little for everyone, and you tend to read that as a bad sign when it is simply what comes next.
personnalite.pf_passion_a: Learn to tell intensity apart from solidity. A relationship that lasts goes through flat weeks, and that doesn't mean love is leaving. The day you can cross a quiet stretch without reading it as falling out of love, you keep everything passion has that's good and lose what it has that's exhausting.
personnalite.pf_devouement_d: Your way of loving goes through actions. You notice what the other person needs, often before they put it into words, and you arrange for it to be handled. You're the kind of person people feel safe with, and that's no small thing: it's what most people are looking for without knowing how to name it. The flip side is familiar to everyone who loves the way you do. From looking after the other person so much, you forget yourself, and you sometimes end up with an invisible tally of everything you gave without ever asking for anything.
personnalite.pf_devouement_a: Ask. Not as a reproach, not on the day the tally overflows: calmly, simply, for what you need. People who give a lot assume the other one will guess, and nobody ever guesses. Receiving as much as you give won't make you less generous, it will make your way of loving sustainable.
personnalite.pf_complicite_d: With you, love looks a lot like a very good friendship, with the rest on top. You need laughter, in-jokes that belong to the two of you, someone whose company makes a car journey as good as a holiday. You avoid heaviness, grand declarations and solemn conversations, which makes you very easy to live with. Where it catches is when a real subject turns up: the joke that defuses everything is also the one that stops you getting to the bottom of it.
personnalite.pf_complicite_a: Keep the humour, it's worth a fortune and plenty of couples would like half of it. But give yourself two or three conversations a year where you forbid yourself from being funny: the ones about what hurts, what's missing, what comes next. They don't break the lightness of the rest, they put something solid underneath it.
personnalite.pf_construction_d: You don't fall in love at random, and you own it. You look at whether two lives can fit together: the pace, the money, the children, where you want to live. It isn't calculation, it's a way of taking love seriously, and it spares your relationships dead ends that others only discover after three years. Your weak spot is the flip side of your strength: from checking so carefully whether it can work, you sometimes miss what is actually happening.
personnalite.pf_construction_a: Leave room for what can't be checked. Every box ticked doesn't make a story, and a five-year plan is no substitute for an evening you hadn't planned. Every now and then, say yes before you've thought it all the way through: that's often where the most organised couples catch their best memories.
personnalite.pf_equilibre_d: None of your four ways of loving takes over, and that is a result in itself. Depending on the person and the moment, you know how to be intense, to take care, to make someone laugh or to build. That flexibility is a genuine strength: you adapt to whoever you love instead of asking them to adapt to a single set of instructions. The risk comes down to one habit: making do with everything, and never saying clearly what you need.
personnalite.pf_equilibre_a: Look at the two tallest bars below anyway, they're the ones that say the most about you. And ask yourself the question your balance lets you avoid: what do you need, personally, to feel loved? The answer exists for people who can do a bit of everything too.
personnalite.q1: You've been seeing each other two weeks. Where's your head at?
personnalite.q1a: I think about them all the time, I've never felt this good.
personnalite.q1b: I'm already looking for what would make them happy.
personnalite.q1c: I'm enjoying it, I'm not asking myself the question yet.
personnalite.q1d: I'm checking whether our two lives can actually fit.
personnalite.q2: The perfect evening for two would be which one?
personnalite.q2a: The one where we laughed until our cheeks hurt.
personnalite.q2b: The one where we talked about our plans, calmly.
personnalite.q2c: A dinner where we don't see anyone but each other.
personnalite.q2d: The one where I cooked exactly what they love.
personnalite.q3: What you couldn't put up with in a relationship:
personnalite.q3a: Everything I give never coming back to me.
personnalite.q3b: The spark going out and the two of us ending up as flatmates.
personnalite.q4: Your partner is going through a rough patch:
personnalite.q4a: We sit down and look for a concrete solution.
personnalite.q4b: I find something to take their mind off it.
personnalite.q4c: I take over everything else so they can breathe.
personnalite.q4d: I live it with them, it shakes me just as much.
personnalite.q5: What you've already been blamed for in love:
personnalite.q6: The first « I love you », how does it go with you?
personnalite.q6a: It arrives laughing, almost as a joke.
personnalite.q6b: It gets said once I know where this is going.
personnalite.q6c: It comes out on its own, often very fast.
personnalite.q6d: It gets proved long before it gets said.
personnalite.q7: Your friends would say about you:
personnalite.q7a: « They'd do anything for the other one. »
personnalite.q7c: « Those two know where they're going. »
personnalite.q7d: « They spend their time teasing each other. »
personnalite.q8: You're moving in together. Your first instinct:
personnalite.q8a: Setting the budget, the chores, who pays for what.
personnalite.q8b: Throwing the housewarming before the boxes are empty.
personnalite.q8c: Making sure they get the room they wanted.
personnalite.q8d: Making a nest that belongs to just the two of us.
personnalite.q9a: Something symbolic, with a handwritten note.
personnalite.q9b: The thing they've needed for months without buying it.
personnalite.q9c: Something absurd, a joke only the two of you get.
personnalite.q10: The ideal argument, if such a thing exists, ends how?
personnalite.q10a: With a fit of laughter that breaks the whole thing.
personnalite.q10b: With a clear rule so it doesn't come back.
personnalite.q10c: With a reconciliation almost worth the argument.
personnalite.q10d: With a step from me to calm everyone down.
personnalite.q11: What holds you in a relationship the most:
personnalite.q11a: The idea of really mattering to someone.
personnalite.q11b: The chemistry. When it's there, there's no arguing.
personnalite.q11c: The feeling of building something together.
personnalite.q11d: The pleasure of being with that person, simply.
personnalite.q12: Your partner goes away for a week without you:
personnalite.q12a: Fine by me, we both had things to get done.
personnalite.q12b: We send each other nonsense every single day.
personnalite.q12c: I get their return ready: shopping, cleaning, all set.
personnalite.q12d: I count the days, and I own it.
personnalite.q13: Ten years in, what would success look like?
personnalite.q13a: We still look at each other the way we did on day one.
personnalite.q13b: They're happier than the day we met.
personnalite.q13c: We still laugh at the same stupid things.
personnalite.q13d: We built what we said we would build.
personnalite.q14a: After months of friendship and banter.
personnalite.q14b: When I can see this could genuinely work.
personnalite.q14c: All at once, there's nothing to discuss.
personnalite.q14d: Bit by bit, by taking care of the other person.
personnalite.q15: The compliment that would please you most:
personnalite.q15b: « Nobody has ever loved me like this. »
personnalite.q15c: « With you, I know where I'm going. »
